body.statement: For every triangular array \((B^{(n)},w^{(n)},q^{(n)})\) and every fixed \(0<\alpha\le1/4\), \[\mathcal R_\alpha(w^{(n)},q^{(n)})\to0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\omega_\alpha(w^{(n)},q^{(n)})\to0\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\rho_0(w^{(n)},q^{(n)})\to0.\] In particular, \(S^{(n)}\to0\) is sufficient but not necessary.
body.justification: The if-and-only-if boundary replaces the misleading requirement that untrimmed Horvitz--Thompson variance vanish.
body.gap: BasseAiroldi2018 gives an impossibility warning and UganderYin2023 mitigates small probabilities by changing design; neither characterizes consistency for this fixed unequal-block experiment.
body.consumer: Designers can separate intrinsically uninformative experiments from those destabilized only by negligible inverse-probability coordinates.
